issues: The ## section heading is clever-only ('Should you copy Clay's homepage shift?') with no searchable terms — lacks 'positioning', 'messaging', 'CTA', or 'conversion'.

The term 'pipeline' is used twice (H3 'Who should NOT copy this', paragraph 1 and paragraph 3 of H3 'The test before you copy') without a plain-language definition at first use.
H3 'Who should NOT copy this' paragraph 1 exceeds 60 words (approximately 65 words).
H3 'Who should NOT copy this' paragraph 2 exceeds 60 words (approximately 68 words).
